<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex705-1104-2023-06-29" status="reviewed"><lg><l>bsod naMs 'di yis skye bo dam pa de dang de ||</l> <l>bdud kyi tshogs bcom rkang gnyis gtso' bor gyur pa dang ||</l> <l><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:3831">bdag</rs> kyang de dag rjes su byang chub mchog thob nas ||</l> <l>'gro rnams zhi ba'i lam la rab du 'god gyur cig ||</l></lg><note type="translation">Trough these merits, may each and every excellent man become the best of the biped (i.e., a Buddha) who conquers the armies of demons, and
May I, too, obtain the excellent awakening after them, and
May then beings be established in the path of pacification.</note></seg></TEI>
